sources.label: 議案審議結果一覧（令和7年市議会定例会令和8年2月定例議会）

name: 公示送達の通知方法を定め直す
summary: 条例では、聴聞や弁明の機会を知らせる通知を公示送達で行うとき、通知内容などを事務所の掲示場に掲示する方法が定められています。この議案では、通知内容を広く閲覧できる状態にしたうえで、書面の掲示または事務所の電子画面で閲覧できるようにします。これらの措置を始めてから2週間が過ぎると、通知が届いたものとみなします。
changes: 通知内容を規則で定める方法で不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする
通知内容を書いた書面の掲示または事務所の電子画面での閲覧を可能にする
措置を始めてから2週間後に通知が届いたものとみなす
「処理基準」を「処分基準」に改める
who: 聴聞や弁明の機会について公示送達で通知を受ける人
why: 行政手続法の一部改正に伴い、公示送達による通知方法の規定を整えるためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Redefines how notices are served by publication
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ome City Administrative Procedure Ordinance
en.summary: The ordinance sets out a method for notices about hearings or opportunities to explain to be served by publication: posting the notice details and other information on a notice board at the office. This bill makes the notice details widely accessible, then allows them to be viewed either through a posted written notice or on an electronic screen at the office. The notice is deemed to have been delivered two weeks after these measures begin.
changes: Make the notice details accessible to an unspecified number of people using a method set by rules
Allow the written notice to be posted or the notice to be viewed on an electronic screen at the office
Deem the notice delivered two weeks after the measures begin
who: People receiving notices about hearings or opportunities to explain by service by publication
People receiving notices about hearings or opportunities to explain by service by publication
People receiving notices about hearings or opportunities to explain by service by publication
People receiving notices about hearings or opportunities to explain by service by publication
en.why: The city says this is to update the provisions on methods of notice by service by publication in line with a partial amendment to the Administrative Procedure Act.
